title: catha dryandri
intro: Catha dryandri, commonly known as Khat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It has been used for centuries for its medicinal and stimulant properties. The health benefits of Khat include improving alertness and reducing fatigue, as well as its potential therapeutic actions in treating depression, anxiety, and appetite suppression. The bioactive constituents of Khat include cathinone, cathine, and catharanthine, which are responsible for its psychoactive and stimulant effects.
